candidate.data_scope: Quantiacs cryptodaily OHLCV plus historical is_liquid only

hypothesis.primary: A dual-horizon subset lattice can reduce fast-Pareto selection brittleness: descend to the fast/slow skyline intersection when it preserves cap-filling capacity, otherwise ascend to their union and finally to the broad root state rather than forcing an over-pruned book.
hypothesis.fast_geometry: incumbent five-dimensional Pareto panel: Sharpe7/vol14, SMA12/48 trend, momentum14, drawdown30, inverse vol14
hypothesis.slow_geometry: exactly doubled horizons: Sharpe14/vol28, SMA24/96 trend, momentum28, drawdown60, inverse vol28

lattice_states.root: broad incumbent positive-state gate with both horizon panels valid

hypothesis.resolver: Use meet if it preserves required capacity; else join; else root.
hypothesis.capacity_rule: required survivors = min(root survivors, 4), where 4 is derived from the frozen 25% name cap and gross<=1 rather than tuned from returns.
hypothesis.score_formula: Keep incumbent fast score unchanged: ((Sharpe7 - liquid mean Sharpe7 + 0.10*cross-sectional sd)+)^1.20 / (vol14 + 0.015), followed by causal 3-day smoothing and capped normalization.
hypothesis.expected_failure_mode: The slow skyline adds no information beyond the fast geometry, or the conflict-aware ascent dilutes the useful fast Pareto filter and converges toward the root/no-Pareto control.

controls.base_pareto: Exact frozen Pareto <=1 incumbent formula, including its original fast-only validity/warmup path.
controls.root_only: Destroy both skyline refinements and retain only the broad positive-state gate.
controls.meet_only: Force the fast/slow intersection even when it over-prunes cap-filling capacity.
controls.join_only: Always use the conservative fast/slow union, destroying the conflict-sensitive descent/ascent rule.
controls.slow_only: Use only the doubled-horizon skyline inside the shared root.
controls.anti_slow: Destructive direction control: retain fast-skyline names that are dominated by at least two peers in the slow geometry.

pre_economic_mechanics.note: These are synthetic implementation checks only and contain no market-return evidence.
